Final for Publication

File Number: 23114-T1
17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Substitute Narrative & Plans — 4411 West Diversey Avenue, Chicago. IL

Proposed Zoning: C3-1 Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District
Lot Area: 21,022 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change in order to renovate the existing
gas station and construct a new one-story accessory retail convenience store
at the subject property. The new retail convenience store building will
contain 4,000 sq. ft. of floor area and measure 24 ft.-8 in. in height. The
subject property will provide ten (10) onsite parking spaces. Pursuant to
Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation of
the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking all zoning relief,
as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached
plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 4,000 square feet (0.19 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): No dwelling units proposed

© The amount of off-street parking: 10 parking spaces

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 79 feet
b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 70 feet-6 inches
East Side: 4 feet-4 inches
c. Rear Setback: 12 inches

(E) Building Height: 24 feet-8 inches
